name: agent-loop-sidecar-stdio-rejected
about: PILOTDECK_AGENT_LOOP_TRANSPORT=stdio，sidecar 换成一个只会握手、对 execute 直接回 ok:false、final:true、outcome failed、code DEADLINE_EXCEEDED 的脚本（模拟执行到达 sidecar 时截止时间已过，基线 sidecar 自己的写法见 agentLoopSidecarServer.ts:224-236）。基线客户端（agentLoopSidecarClient.ts:780-788、1353-1388 rejectedExecuteTerminal）把它当成一次被拒绝的执行：终态 error，stopReason 为 aborted_streaming（code 是 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED 时），errors 里是 agent_execution_rejected，message「Sidecar rejected execute request: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED」，details 带 sidecarCode。握手部分与 agent-loop-sidecar-stdio-crash 相同（binding 写死在脚本里），脚本收到 EOF 后以 0 退出。比较帧、会话记录与运行记录。 标题请求延迟 1.5 秒，让标题记录稳定落在失败记录之后。

files.proj/reject-sidecar.sh:
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"hello-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","ok":true,"protocolVersion":"2.0","moduleId":"pilotdeck-agent-loop","moduleInstanceId":"fake-instance","connectionGeneration":"fake-instance-generation","capabilitiesVersion":"1","payload":{}}\n' "$id"
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"capabilities-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","ok":true,"protocolVersion":"2.0","moduleId":"pilotdeck-agent-loop","moduleInstanceId":"fake-instance","connectionGeneration":"fake-instance-generation","capabilitiesVersion":"1","payload":{"capabilitiesVersion":"1","methods":[{"name":"execute","enabled":true,"profiles":["streaming"],"cancel":true,"resumeSupport":"none","retry":"retry_after_status"},{"name":"cancel","enabled":true},{"name":"status","enabled":true},{"name":"resume","enabled":false},{"name":"ack","enabled":false}]}}\n' "$id"
read -r line
id=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"kind":"request","messageId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
req=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/.*"operationId":"[^"]*","requestId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
printf '{"kind":"response","messageId":"deadline-fake","inReplyTo":"%s","requestId":"%s","ok":false,"final":true,"outcome":"failed","code":"DEADLINE_EXCEEDED"}\n' "$id" "$req"
while read -r line; do :; done
exit 0
